title: The Blacksmith of Fate
description: A stern older man with gray hair sits centered at a stone anvil, both hands resting on its surface. He wears a simple tunic with a glowing black orb covered in white symbols on his chest, while ethereal, translucent angelic wings with mathematical and alchemical symbols float behind him.
prompt: A stern older man with short gray hair and serious expression sits at a stone anvil inside a brick celestial forge under a starry night sky visible through arched windows. He wears a simple off-white tunic with a large glowing black sphere covered in intricate white runes and symbols on his chest. Translucent ghostly angelic wings made of mathematical equations, constellations, and alchemical symbols float behind and around him. Chains and ropes lie on the anvil. Dramatic atmospheric lighting with soft glows, mystical and symbolic surreal style.
